notes.platforms.macos.real.probes.font_names.p: Host-specific: the baseline Mac has SF Pro hand-installed in /Library/Fonts. Stock macOS reads false, so a macOS persona reading false is not a gap.
notes.platforms.windows.real.probes.css (windo: The real Windows baseline is a restored (non-maximized) window: chromeWidth 15, chromeHeight 94. Personas are maximized by design; real maximized Chrome 154 on Windows reads chromeWidth 0, chromeHeight 87, screenX/Y 0/0 and an event screen-minus-client offset of (0, 87), which is what the persona reports.
notes.ours: Harness launch (detect.py with the daemon's argv, profile prefs and WebRTC args). The daemon-attached run matched it; its languages follow the egress geoip, so it is not recorded here.
notes.platforms.*.real.probes.worker.page.time: Redacted: it is the reference machine's local zone, not a property of Chrome. A persona's zone follows its proxy's geoip.
